planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno. Wiring provided/authorized pins are A0 (analog source) and D13 (LED output). No other explicit wiring is provided, so no other catalog port requests are generated.

A0-to-D13 threshold logic (A0 > 500 => LED on else off) is assumed to be implemented in the SysML model using the analog_input value and a model-side comparator; no additional device timing/threshold logic is included here.

Active-high behavior for the LED is assumed by using digital_output catalog default polarity; initial is set to false (LED off) to match typical startup behavior when no initial analog measurement requirement is specified.
